problem: Production could already be visible and working while chat reported only main or continued delivery work, creating ambiguity about whether development was still needed.
root_cause: Repository state, Netlify deployment state, functional website state and governance closure were collapsed into one concept.
prevention: report MAIN, NETLIFY_PRODUCTION, WEBSITE_READBACK, LIVE and BORGING separately
reconcile current production before reacting to a repeated live request
when requested behavior is already live, do not start new development/PR/deploy solely because closure metadata is incomplete
classify remaining skills/agents/chats/Brain/docs/ledger/System Map work as BORGING_PENDING
charts_and_control_surfaces: Delivery charts must expose all five dimensions and may not equate main/deploy/live.
terminal_user_format: MAIN ✓ | NETLIFY PRODUCTION ✓ | WEBSITE READBACK ✓ | LIVE ✓ | BORGING ✓
